claim: On macOS, the current source- and executable-bound R-SURFACE-008 curses route enters the real use-item direction loop through advertised native inventory controls and consumes only current direction tokens.
material_proof: One selected current-bound run finds the fixture lighter by its advertised inventory UID, enters its native use flow, observes a direction descriptor, chooses one advertised direction token, records an exact receipt and fresh successor, rejects an invalid or stale control without selecting a direction, cancels, and accepts cleanup. Fixture manufacture and inventory entry are zero-credit.
material_contradiction: a direction is chosen by raw input, label, row, coordinate, OCR, screenshot, or direct mutation
an invalid, stale, parent-World, or unadvertised control selects a direction
a receipt lacks the consuming direction frame or cleanup fails
already_accepted_evidence: The focused direction adapter has source tests and an object build, but neither establishes the live curses renderer route.
current_uncertainty: No current source-bound curses direction witness has exercised native inventory entry, direction binding, exact receipt, invalid control, and return.
forbidden_shortcuts: physical keys, mouse, labels, rows, coordinates, OCR, screenshots, fallback dispatch, or direct state mutation
crediting fixture manufacture or inventory entry
honest_stop_conditions: stop before launch if the selected binding is not current
after launch stop on missing receipt, binding drift, unintended selection, forbidden dispatch, or cleanup contradiction
seal and finish when the direction route and invalid control are settled
